result:
I've implemented round 29 (TM-B31 / D-36). When a folder read's chunk fails at the IPC level, the files in that chunk now keep the values already shown instead of disappearing. Rescan, Open Folder and drop then show the same `Failed to read N files` error toast the schema path already uses. All local checks pass. The real-app check on old vs new builds (R29-5) is C's, and I did not run it.

**What changed** (exactly the 10 permitted files; the new test is the only untracked file; no commits):
- **`lib/utils.ts`:** `readMetadataChunked` now also returns `failedPaths`, the paths of every failed chunk in order. `failures` equals its length.
- **`file-store.ts`:** `applyMetadataRead` takes a required third parameter, `keptPaths`. For each kept path it keeps the entry the store holds at write time, or leaves the path out if there is none.
- **`FolderBrowser.tsx`** (`handleOpenFolder`, `handleRescan`) and **`App.tsx`** (`openFolder`): only the success path changed. They pass `failedPaths` and show the toast when `failures > 0`.
- **Tests:** a new file with (k1)–(k7), plus (g3), (u2), and the `[]` argument added to the one (g2) call.
- **Docs:**
  - `docs/bugs/001`: new entry 12; entry 11 now names (r8) and has the two known-limit sentences; header, D-36 bullet and shifted line references updated.
  - `README.md`: row 001 reads exactly as the task specifies.
  - `STATE_MANAGEMENT.md`: one D-36 line added, and the signature token in the D-35 line updated.

**What I ran:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| New tests on the old src, before the fix | 8 failed / 227 passed, as planned; (k7) passes. Re-run after a later test tweak gave the same result. |
| Full `verifyCommand` from a clean state, one run | exit 0: Biome 0 errors and the same 8 warnings as round 28, typecheck clean, renderer 235/235, main 93/93, E2E 7/7 |
| E2E with `--retries=0` | 7/7 |
| Each new test run alone | all pass |

**Code review:** the `code-reviewer` subagent found nothing blocking. I took its suggestion to add one assertion to (k6).

**Open points for B/C:**
- **A-R29-01 (low, test gap, confirmed):** no test has two failed chunks. A mutant that keeps only the last failed chunk's paths still passes all 235 tests (I ran it in a `/tmp` copy). It isn't in R29-3's list. A test with 151 files where chunks 1 and 3 fail would catch it; I didn't add one because it would change the planned count of 235.
- **A-R29-02 (low, wording from an earlier round):** the docs say an empty folder still calls `setMetadata({})`. That is only true for Rescan; Open Folder and drop on an empty folder keep the old metadata.
- **One addition beyond the spec:** in the D-35 bullet I also added a clause saying paths in `keptPaths` are kept. With the new signature, the old wording was no longer accurate. It is listed in the report; C may ask for it to be removed.
- **Result JSON:** I did not write an `a-round-29-*.json`. The `a-round-N-result.json` files from earlier rounds are session dumps the harness writes, not A.

**Acceptance I passed myself:** the red→green part of R29-2 and the gate part of R29-4. R29-1, R29-3, R29-5 and R29-6 are C's checks. Windows packaging is BLOCKED: Windows packaging is not available in the cloud.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/tag-manager-loop/`:
- a-round-29.md
- a-round-29/checkpoint.md
- a-round-29/verify.log
